# B1 transcript fixtures

Shapes of the transcript entries that follow a handover write, taken from Claude Code
2.1.300 transcripts: a tool call and its result, hook attachments, a queued prompt, a
task notification, local command output, meta entries and bookkeeping entries. Keys and
shapes are real; every path, id, uuid, timestamp, branch and text is a placeholder in
angle brackets that the tests fill in (`conftest.b1_entry`).
